title: Carpet pile seen from above
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of carpet: cut-pile tuft tips with twisted plies, loop pile in rows, flecked berber loops or long shag strands, with pile shading. Use for floors, rugs, stair runners, car interiors and office carpet in interiors and archviz.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python carpet_pile.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pile
parameters.meaning: 0 cut pile (tuft tips), 1 loop pile in rows, 2 berber (fat flecked loops), 3 shag (long strands over a short pile).

parameters.name: tufts
parameters.meaning: Tufts (or loops) across the tile width; the grid is square, so as many rows run down the tile.

parameters.name: tuft_size
parameters.meaning: Tuft or loop thickness relative to the tuft spacing; low values show the backing.

parameters.name: twist
parameters.meaning: Visibility of the twisted plies in each tuft or loop.

parameters.name: flecks
parameters.meaning: Share of tufts in the fleck colour, as in berber or tweed carpets.

parameters.name: shading
parameters.meaning: Light and dark patches of pile lying in different directions.

parameters.name: shag_length
parameters.meaning: Length of the long shag strands in texture units (pile 3 only).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Beige cut-pile plush carpet with soft shading.

presets.name: grey_loop
presets.description: Grey commercial loop pile in tight rows.

presets.name: berber_oat
presets.description: Oatmeal berber: fat nubby loops with dark flecks.

presets.name: shag_cream
presets.description: Cream shag rug: long tangled strands over a short pile.

presets.name: red_plush
presets.description: Deep red velvet plush with strong pile shading.

limits: Seen from straight above: tufts are domes and loops are capsules on a jittered square grid, not modelled yarn; pile depth shows only through height, normals and occlusion. Shag strands are bent two-segment strokes painted with a z-buffer, so very long strands look stiff. Pile shading is noise, not a record of footprints or a vacuum pattern. Patterned rugs, borders and fringes are out of scope. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic.
technique_references: Jittered tuft grid with whole tuft counts on the torus
Spiral ply highlight from the angle and radius inside each tuft
Superellipse loop capsules along tufting rows
Z-buffered stroke painting of shag strands
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
